title: Felipe Vidal Santiago and the umbrella man on the grassy knoll

tellings.quote: I mean, you see Phil Fid Felipe Fidal Santiago on the Grassy Null.

plain: A Cuban exile named Felipe Vidal Santiago can be seen on the grassy knoll, the small slope in Dealey Plaza, Dallas, where President John F. Kennedy was shot in 1963, and he is tied to the so-called umbrella man standing there, according to the researcher Dan Sheehan. Sheehan says this without naming a source, telling Michels, "you see Felipe Vidal Santiago on the Grassy Knoll," and points to the House Select Committee, the congressional panel that looked again at the killing in the 1970s. He tells it as evidence that more people were involved in the shooting than the official account allows.
